reviews.review: An absolutely fantastic rougelite game. Fast paced, different paths, lots of secrets. Now includes the most OP weapon: A pair of frying pans.
If you like games like Hades, Dead Cells, Slay the Spire, Curse of the dead Gods, Death must die, Hellcard, Ravenswatch and really, really love Doom: This is it!

Overwhelmingly Positive? You mean Overwhelmingly Awesome!

It feels like someone blended together the best elements between Doom, Borderlands, and Deadcells to make a Bumblebee robot smoothie. I just love it.

EASY TO PICK UP, HARD TO PUT DOWN!

So this game isn't hiding anything from you, you get what you saw in the trailers. It's all about speed and a load of weapons to dispose hoards of robots trying to scratch your paint job all at once. If you enjoy any of the games I mentioned already, you'll feel right at home. 

The Story:
It's quarky, charming, and hardly important yet lovable. I also enjoy how the story elements are off to the side and not in the way as well, allowing you to focus more on the gameplay which is it's strong suit. And man, is that gameplay really enjoyable! 

The Levels:
The game has you going through countless "stages" you could call them between maps and locations. Each stage has a couple of rooms and a ton of enemies based on the location your in and the level you've reached up to. Each stage also has a tone of secrets too that you should look out for. Sometimes these are in the form of secret rooms, purple puzzle areas, or doorways that require you to do something ahead of time or have something on you to pass through them.

Maps are enjoyable and not repetitive. Of course you do run across similar maps here and there, but in a game like this it's just nice to see a well made map that isn't something bare or generic. I approve.

The Music:
Music here fits the pacing and is enjoyable. It's not Doom levels of music, but it's also not so bad that it makes you want to gouge your eyes out after the track repeats itself for the millionth time. Id rank it a good 8/10. Not perfect, but certainly has me jamming out of my seat when I'm playing.

THE ARSENAL!:
WEAPONS! We have tons of weapons! Weapons are as sharp and responsive as the movement controls, the level of detail is fantastic, and the options of which and what to choose feel endless. I can't stress enough how enjoyable it is to take a hammer that says it "Bonks" enemies only to use it for the first time and actually see the words "BONK" displayed above the enemies head after you finish your said bonking. True genius.

So if you ever dreamed of Bumblebee rampaging through a hoard of robots outside of Transformers like it was Doom Eternal than this is the game for you. 

It also has a demo too, so give it a shot, turn off your brain, and enjoy.
a lot of fun alone, nice progress.
If Doom and Risk of Rain were to have a baby, this would be it!
